rows.current_target_text: Choose $\eta,\psi\in C_c^\infty((-1,1))$ with $\eta(0)=1$ and $\int_{-1}^1\psi\ne0$, and for $0<\varepsilon<1$ set $\varphi_\varepsilon(x_1,x_2)=\eta(x_1/\varepsilon)\psi(x_2)$. Then $\varphi_\varepsilon\in C_c^\infty(\Omega)$ and $\|\varphi_\varepsilon\|_2=\sqrt{\varepsilon}\,\|\eta\|_2\|\psi\|_2\to0$. But step 2.1 and the formula in step 1.2 give $\int_\Omega p\varphi_\varepsilon=-2\int_{-1}^1\psi(x_2)\,dx_2$, a fixed nonzero number, whereas Cauchy–Schwarz [F4] forces these integrals to tend to zero. This contradiction proves that no $L^2$ source certificate exists. [F4, step 1.2, step 2.1, choose, algebra] ∎
